expected_difference_confirmed: The h3 one-lining is a Biome 80-column width effect, not a hand edit: at 22 spaces of indentation in kanban-view.tsx the element exceeded the limit and its child was wrapped; at 10 spaces in the new file it fits. JSX strips whitespace containing a newline, so both forms produce an identical single text child. The longer adjacent span staying wrapped at the shallower indent is the control that confirms a width-driven reformat.
